name: Horde Charge [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your energy during a charge is infectious, making their charges more deadly.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, half-orc or orc.

Benefit(s): When charging an enemy, your allies gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls in addition to the normal bonus for charging if they charge as well this turn. If they can make multiple attacks on a charge, this bonus only applies to the first attack.
